userStories.title: Persist next-week commitment from this week's headline moment
acceptanceCriteria: Each weekly digest run writes one follow_ups row keyed by week_iso
commitment_text is taken from the headline moment's suggested_alternative
dim_key matches the headline moment's dim
target_metric is verification_rate, delegation_rate, or '<dim>_dim_mean' as appropriate to the dim
baseline_value records the current value of target_metric at digest generation
outcome is initialized to 'pending'
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Compute outcome from data (improved/unchanged/worse), not LLM
acceptanceCriteria: On the next weekly run, the prior week's follow_ups row is updated with measured_value from the new week's data
outcome = 'improved' iff measured_value > baseline_value + 0.5 (or inverse for delegation_rate)
outcome = 'worse' iff measured_value < baseline_value - 0.5 (or inverse for delegation_rate)
Otherwise outcome = 'unchanged'
The LLM is never asked to decide the outcome
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: praxis follow-up CLI prints current commitment status
acceptanceCriteria: praxis follow-up prints the most recent follow_ups row in human-readable form
Output includes commitment_text, baseline_value, measured_value (or '--' if pending), and outcome
Exits 0 when a follow-up exists, exits 3 with a clear message when none exist yet
